column2: How do I make the contents of a collection (chapters, passages)?
column3: Lists → 📚 Collections → a collection → “📑 Contents” tab. “＋ Chapter…”: a title, from one page to another (e.g. “Marriages 1870”, pages 15 to 19), a record type and years if you want; in a chapter’s “⋯”: “Sub-chapter…” (as many levels as you want) and “Passage in this chapter…”. A passage describes a precise spot without creating a person record: “from the middle of page 5 to the middle of page 7: marriage of Louis LACOMBE and Anne MAZAUD”, with a description. “✨ Suggest a split” looks at the records already transcribed in the Workshop (their type and year) and suggests “Year 1789 › Baptisms 1789…”: you untick, you fix the titles, nothing is added until you accept. Each line expands and collapses (▸ ▾, “Expand all”, “Collapse all”, levels), shows its progress, and a click on its title opens its first page. “📖 Reading mode” shows the contents in large print with the description of the passages. The app flags what’s out of place: two chapters that overlap, a record of another type or from another year. On a page: “📑 Year 1789 › Baptisms 1789”, also in Documents. A bundle (in no order) can be sorted by date, type or shelfmark: Pages tab → “🗃 Sort by…”. Everything can be undone (↶ Undo).
